phil-ex-01-c3.quote: anxiety is the dizziness of freedom, which emerges when the spirit wants to posit the synthesis
phil-ex-01-c3.claim: In The Concept of Anxiety (1844), Kierkegaard treats anxiety (Angst) as the dizziness of freedom.
